title: Cap the Schur bandwidth of a middle interval by 2b-1
body:
## Summary
- A contiguous pivot with survivors on both sides has Schur bandwidth at most `2b-1`. A one-sided pivot stays within `b`.
- Eliminating indices 2 through 4 of the bandwidth-2 witness leaves bandwidth 3, with filled entry `-1/432`. The inverse equals the complementary block and has norms `488/389`, inside the original bounds `2` and `10`.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
